notes.title: Disturbed | 4 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26380148/1ce3868c012f4eb64608e30448e18c9ed5154519.png[/img]

[h2]Where Has the Time Gone?[/h2]
Four years in the past feels so distant and strange. So much has happened and changed, and yet in some ways, things have stayed the same. I speak of the thrill of adventure, the uneasiness of the unknown, and that [i]disturbed[/i] feeling you get when things go wrong. What an inspiration to read about and see so many adventurers traverse the unknown! Happy 4 Years of Disturbed!

[h3]New Death Added[/h3]
Even though there are other projects going on, I couldn't sit by this year as I have in the past. So, regarding this post, the game has received a subtle update that will add some goosebumps to your arms. This may be a little brutal to newcomers but veterans will get a spook from it too I hope. I may need to tweak it later when more people play, but for now, go ahead and wander around. Give the game another go.[i] If for no other reason, it is now the season.[/i]

[spoiler]A vicious spirit has been released to haunt those who travel the lands of Aramor. Be careful not to wander too long.[/spoiler]

Feedback will be appreciated. [i]I was a bit hesitant about adding it in Disturbed Beyond Aramor, but for some reason, it found its way here instead.[/i] ːheartpieceː

notes.title: Status Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26380148/c1ab0dea51523a1f67218ab84ad8383544b11d90.png[/img]
It has been a long time since I have last posted. Right now a [b]new game[/b] is in the works - being designed first for mobile market and then PC release.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26380148/c19334fececbecfcc8fc4d3aad2e3d97fe932421.png[/img]
[b]Think Binding of Isaac combined with animals.[/b] I hope to launch a [b]Kickstarter in the near future[/b] once I have more to share - most likely when I have a mobile demo that can be played for free. [i](that is the plan right now)[/i]

Regarding the Disturbed Series... [i]Disturbed Beyond Aramor[/i] sits at 5 reviews and is $5. Taking account of the return from investment, I will not be doing anymore 'Disturbed' content. I will continue to post announcements here, but if you are interested in future projects/releases, [u]please follow me through Steam and/or follow my Facebook page[/u]. Thank you. :theskull:
[url=www.facebook.com/iblackpen]https://www.facebook.com/iblackpen[/url]

tags.feature: Right now a new game is in the works - being designed first for mobile market and then PC release.

notes.title: Updated Engine + Merchandise
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26380148/35f3010073d3b3399f01ceedfea1719513b32b87.png[/img]
[h1]What's New?[/h1]
- Disturbed has been updated with animated images that are 1280x720.
- New music and additional sounds have been added.
- Engine has been updated

[i]Something to note: Old saved games can still be loaded but you will get an error about a missing variable when going upstairs in the tower. This is due to a variable not being present in the original game. It is recommended to start over and use new saves.[/i]

[i]Another issue was found in listing the translations. The translation should adjust to the language set on Steam.[/i]

If you discover any errors, please post them on the discussion board.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26380148/6793b2c95584cf097be50a78de8768c2a81a2516.png[/img]
[h1]7 Day T-shirt Campaign[/h1]
I thought it would be interesting to see if there was a demand for some merchandise. This is something a couple people have asked for, so I figured why not try it. If there is something I should add or change, please let me know. [i]Time is limited![/i]

https://teespring.com/stores/iblackpens-disturbed

Thank you for your support. :warhorse:

notes.title: The Journey Continues! - Disturbed 2 now on Steam Greenlight!
notes.content:
[h1]The Journey Continues[/h1]
It has been roughly half a year since Disturbed 1 released on steam. A lot has happened since then! With all the English refinements, 8 languages have been added to the game - with more still on the way. Disturbed also got a DLC for those who want keep the game in their library after uninstalling. Also to add, the iblackpen website has been updated to a more pleasing aesthetic. With all this, the adventure will not be ending here! ːwarhorseː

notes.title: Schedule Update
notes.content:
I've had a bad habit of keeping quiet these past couple months. I do think it is good to be a little transparent - not too much, but enough to let people know that stuff is happening. ːwarhorseː

[h1]Here is coming within the next few weeks![/h1]

[b]Updated Website[/b] ːcsgoxː
The new site should be up by 2/24.
[url]http://iblackpen.com/[/url]

[b]Disturbed Supporter DLC[/b]
Although this won't add to the game, it has been requested many times over the past few months to offer it. This will be added within the first week of March.

[b]Disturbed 2 Announcement[/b]
The development of the sequel is going well. I am reaching a point where I can prepare something like a Greenlight campaign. With Steam's announcement regarding Greenlight, I see little harm in putting the game up anyways. My goal is to have things ready and up by March 12th at the latest.
[IMG]http://68.media.tumblr.com/c5539b554fb387c044b7e49b4978dd05/tumblr_oln02vB46n1v8u3k8o2_1280.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Disturbed v1.3
notes.content:
[b]Update Details[/b]
[h1]
+ Small menu bugs fixed
+ Spelling error fixes
+ Minor code fixes
+ Removed 'Help' - Now as a README pdf that steam will hold
+ Added under 'Preferences,' In-game Language Switcher
+ Hebrew Translation
+ Russian Translation
+ Spanish Translation
[/h1]

[b]Summary[/b]
It has been exciting to see the game well received during the past couple weeks. Many individuals from the community deserve credit and a thank you for listing typos, bugs, etc. Also a big thank you for those who took the time to translate the game! Because of the community, the game has grown and improved.

[i]One last thank you -[/i] For those who have taken the time to write a review for the game, it is appreciated. The feedback is important, and will help with the development of future content.
- Brad Moore

[IMG]https://68.media.tumblr.com/6e4fee0c6abbe5b3eba37bf314bc1cf0/tumblr_of02apAq901v8u3k8o1_540.png[/IMG]
